summary_en: Japaneth Holdings filed non-binding intent to take Twinbird private via tender offer at ¥800/share, minimum 7,270,800 shares, 30 business days from late October 2026. Twinbird board unanimously opposes and states tender will be withdrawn if board rejects or takes no stance by 30 October 2026.
title_en: Notice of Statement of Opposition to Commencement of Public Tender Offer for Twinbird Shares by Japaneth Holdings Corporation
translation_en_brief:
On 31 August 2026, Twinbird Corporation filed a notice of opposition to a proposed take-private transaction. Japaneth Holdings Corporation (Japaneth) issued a non-binding letter of intent on 11 May 2026 proposing to acquire all outstanding shares of Twinball via public tender offer at ¥800 per share. The minimum acceptance threshold is 7,270,800 shares; there is no upper limit. The tender is expected to open in late October 2026 and run for 30 business days.

Twinbird's board convened a special committee comprising three independent directors on 27 May 2026 to evaluate whether the proposal constitutes a bona fide offer and to advise on the company's response. The board engaged Plutus Consulting (financial and valuation advisor) and Mori Hamada & Matsumoto (legal counsel).

On 31 August 2026, the full board voted unanimously to oppose the tender. The board states that Japaneth has agreed to withdraw the proposal and abandon the tender if Twinbird opposes it or fails to express a position by 30 October 2026. The disclosure disputes Japaneth's characterization of prior negotiations, asserting that Twinbird never proposed a one-third stake partnership and consistently declined to engage in acquisition discussions from February onwards.
